plugins.description: AEM Edge Delivery Services (Helix 5) Admin API executor with enforced guardrails. Bundles the hlx-admin-api-executor skill with a PreToolUse hook that intercepts destructive curl commands (POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH) targeting admin.hlx.page and blocks execution until the user explicitly approves.

skills.name: hlx-admin-api-executor
skills.description: Interactive AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS/Helix 5) Admin API executor with human-in-the-loop oversight. Use when working with the AEM Admin API (admin.hlx.page) to: (1) Plan and execute admin operations step-by-step (preview, publish, config, access, cache, index, snapshots, code), (2) Execute ONE API request at a time with human review and approval, (3) Document all requests/responses in EXECUTION.md with full traceability, (4) Follow GET/SET/GET verification patterns for safe configuration changes, (5) Resume existing executions and add new steps, (6) Manage site configuration, access control, content operations, and code deployments. For careful AEM admin operations where mistakes are costly - NOT for bulk automation.
skills.description_zh: 逐步执行 AEM EDS/Helix 5 Admin API 预览、发布、配置、权限、缓存、索引、快照和代码操作，每次仅一个请求并由人工审阅批准，将请求响应写入 EXECUTION.md，按 GET/SET/GET 验证并可续接，不用于批量自动化。
